title: Crispy Japanese Tagine
description: A crispy, Japanese-inspired twist on traditional tagine. Perfect for a snack or light meal.
instructions: Cook Japanese rice according to package instructions.
In a pan, heat 1 tbsp of vegetable oil over medium-high heat.
Add Japanese-style crispy noodles and cook until crispy, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove noodles from pan and set aside.
In the same pan, add 1 tbsp of vegetable oil and cook the green onions until crispy, about 2 minutes.
Add the cooked Japanese rice to the pan, stirring to combine with the green onions.
Add the tagine spice blend and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Stir in soy sauce and sesame oil.
Return the crispy noodles to the pan and stir to combine.
Serve hot, garnished with additional green onions if desired.
